scope: Pre-disc startup attribution; no gameplay or performance acceptance claim

method.profile: Existing foreground Chrome profile; manual Record then Reload.
method.cache: Not cleared; cache disabling was off.
method.throttling: CPU and network throttling were off.
method.screenshots: 450 trace screenshots; OCR was sampled on every fifth screenshot (91 samples, about 134 ms apart). Screenshot pixels were inspected transiently and not retained.
method.scope: Only the staging navigation/runtime origin was summarized; unrelated tabs and profile fields are excluded.

preparing_graphics_label.interpretation: Sampled visibility bracket only, not exact label start/end or readiness time. The 14.57 s trace tail is not startup duration.

wasm.interpretation: Slices may be nested or overlap; summed duration is not an independent CPU attribution. Trace records a Wasm module-cache hit.

sampled_positive_label_interval.largest_task_attribution: The 93.025 ms RunTask at +1272.108 ms has no nested source/function event in this trace, so it cannot be assigned to a runtime or native function.

main_renderer_thread.interpretation: Main-thread task time does not show continuous CPU saturation during sampled label visibility. The 93 ms task is not attributed to a specific native/JS operation.

supported: This is a warm, mostly cached load.
The observed label window is not explained by sustained main-renderer CPU occupancy in this trace.
Ordinary request timing and recorded Wasm compilation slices end early relative to the sampled label interval.
unresolved: The trace does not identify whether startupCacheReady or Module.pipelinePreparation.ready held the label; runtime refreshCatalogLoading uses either condition.
No direct WebGPU shader/pipeline creation event was identified, so the trace does not attribute the remaining wait to pipeline compilation, native initialization, or GPU queue readiness.
A single warm reload does not characterize cold-cache behavior or reproduce the user's full 10–15 s report.

limits: No cache-cleared, throttled, or repeated comparison was performed.
Chrome PipelineReporter markers are not evidence of WebGPU pipeline compilation.
Do not infer startup duration from the trace recording tail.

fire_animation_frame.interpretation: Dispatch timestamps include short callback bursts; raw interarrival p50 is not the frame cadence.

frame_lifecycle.interpretation: The sampled interval contains regular frame callbacks plus intermittent longer gaps; this is a trace observation, not proof that frame pacing caused the graphics label.
